video_title: Has it been a disappointing offseason for the Detroit Pistons?! 😬 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers and Cavaliers actively pursuing Jonathan Kuminga via sign-and-trade
quotes.excerpt: Lakers and Cavaliers are continuing a pretty active pursuit for Jonathan Kuminga to bring him in.
quotes.quote: Let's look at one of the top name free agents right now, unrestricted this time around, Jonathan Kuminga. The Lakers and Cavaliers are continuing a pretty active pursuit for Jonathan Kuminga to bring him in. He represents a high-level potential starting-caliber player for both of these teams, but whatever deal could happen will likely be a sign-and-trade. So that's where both the Lakers and Cavs would need the Hawks to work with them on a Kuminga deal, and they would also have to get Kuminga on the same page with them on a potential deal.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Bulls and Pelicans interested in restricted free agent Bennedict Mathurin
quotes.excerpt: Both the Bulls and the Pelicans are among the interested teams in Mathurin.
quotes.quote: Another player in free agency, this is a restricted free agent, Bennedict Mathurin. Both the Bulls and the Pelicans are among the interested teams in Mathurin. He is just 24 years old. We have known he can score the ball at a high level on the big stage. He did it for the Pacers in route to that 2025 run to the finals. The Clippers do have some interest in resigning Mathurin, but they are in the middle of this holding pattern that is the Kawhi Leonard investigation.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Heat prioritize acquiring Klay Thompson via trade or buyout
quotes.excerpt: Sources tell me Klay is the Heat's number one priority right now to acquire.
quotes.quote: Let's finish with a four-time NBA champion, Klay Thompson. Sources tell me Klay is the Heat's number one priority right now to acquire, whether that's via trade or buyout. He has one year left on his deal with the Dallas Mavericks, so the Mavs are exploring whether that could end up in a trade or a buyout. There are multiple suitors as well in the marketplace beyond just the Heat, so we will see where Klay Thompson could end up.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Pistons banking on internal improvement after failing to make big moves
quotes.excerpt: Baking on internal improvement has been the thought going back from last summer.

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: Can you just take us inside what is their strategy at this point?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Baking on internal improvement has been the thought going back from last summer when they didn't make a big move. Going into this season they wanted to see how Jaylen Duren and Ausar Thompson and Ron Holland would play together, led to 60 wins. Now you are thinking Detroit was going to go make a big move this past offseason. Cade Cunningham was very involved in the potential recruitment of Austin Reaves. Austin Reaves resigned with the Lakers, Kevin Durant, Kawhi Leonard, Kyrie Irving, those were all names the Pistons were interested in. No moves materialized and now they are going to bank on the restricted free agent of Jaylen Duren and Ausar Thompson's extension.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Pistons should prioritize team chemistry over contract negotiations
quotes.excerpt: They shouldn't be dealing with this whole contract negotiation thing with an all-NBA player.
quotes.quote: To be honest with you, it's to the point now where you want us, I want to see the Detroit Pistons like doing something with what Lucas is doing with the Los Angeles Lakers that Dave reported, you know, flying his teammates and having some type of togetherness. They shouldn't be dealing with this whole contract negotiation thing with an all-NBA player that they have, a youngster in Jaylen Duren. And when you think about what they lost this offseason, they lost Tobias Harris, who was crucial for them last year. One could argue he was their most reliable second option in the postseason.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Pistons failed to acquire a second option for Cade Cunningham
quotes.excerpt: The number one thing a lot of people were looking at this offseason, who was Detroit going to go after.
quotes.quote: The number one thing a lot of people were looking at this offseason, who was Detroit going to go after to get a second option. They have not gotten a second option. And Cade Cunningham had an MVP-worthy season last year. He was top five on my ballot. What they are going to expect to do is more improvement for Cade Cunningham. Maybe that's too much responsibility to put on one player, but the Pistons do have two $15 million trade exceptions. They want to have some flexibility going into the season to make some moves in season, but it's also placing once again a lot of responsibility on Cade.
